title: Auteur: an agent skill that treats landing-page development like film direction

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Aur is an agent skill that treats landing page development like film direction, locking the art direction in a commit sheet before writing markup. It can scout references, generate assets, and build WebGL or scroll-driven scenes from recipes. Shipping is gated by executable checks. Slopcan rejects cliche styling and accessibility mistakes, while Motion QA measures dropped frames and browser errors.
